abstract: AIM: The aim of this study was to evaluate the correlation between clinicopathological characteristics and serum levels of tumor markers in patients with ovarian endometrioma (OE) and ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT). MATERIAL AND METHODS: Values of CA125, CA19-9, and sialyl Tn antigen (STN) were retrospectively investigated in 321 patients with OE. CA125, CA19-9, STN, and squamous cell carcinoma antigen (SCC) were examined in 435 patients with MCT. RESULTS: Mean values of CA125, CA19-9, and STN were 105.3 U/mL, 58.0 U/mL, and 31.1 U/mL in OE, while the values were 26.8 U/mL, 246.8 U/mL, and 24.7 U/mL in MCT. Abnormal elevation of CA125, CA19-9, and STN was observed in 53.3%, 38.9, and 13.5 of OE, and in 12.9, 50.6, and 4.6% of MCT, respectively. CA125 level was significantly higher in bilaterally occurring OE and premenopausal patients with MCT, while the value of CA19-9 was significantly higher in cases of bilaterally occurring MCT. Furthermore, the levels of CA125 and CA19-9 showed significant correlations with tumor diameter, while the levels of STN and SCC showed no significant correlations with tumor diameter. The highest CA125 level (9513 U/mL) was observed in OE and the highest CA19-9 level (25 590 U/mL) was observed in MCT. CONCLUSION: Although abnormal increases in the levels of CA125 and CA19-9 were often observed, the levels of STN were not influenced by clinicopathologic factors in OE and MCT. Further studies of the clinical usefulness of STN for detecting malignant tumors in OE and MCT are needed.
abstract_ja: 【目的】本研究の目的は、卵巣子宮内膜症(OE)および卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)患者における臨床病理学的特徴と血清腫瘍マーカーとの相関を評価することであった。【材料と方法】321例のOE患者においてCA125、CA19-9、シアリルTn抗原(STN)の値を後方視的に検討した。435例のMCT患者においては、CA125、CA19-9、STN、扁平上皮癌抗原(SCC)を測定した。【結果】OEにおけるCA125、CA19-9、STNの平均値は、それぞれ105.3 U/mL、58.0 U/mL、31.1 U/mLであった。一方、MCTではそれぞれ26.8 U/mL、246.8 U/mL、24.7 U/mLであった。OEの53.3%、38.9%、13.5%、MCTの12.9%、50.6%、4.6%で、CA125、CA19-9、STNの異常高値が認められた。両側性OEおよび閉経前のMCT患者ではCA125が有意に高値であった。両側性MCTではCA19-9が有意に高値であった。さらに、CA125とCA19-9の値は腫瘍径と有意な相関を示したが、STNとSCCの値は腫瘍径と有意な相関を示さなかった。CA125の最高値(9513 U/mL)はOEで、CA19-9の最高値(25590 U/mL)はMCTで認められた。【結論】CA125とCA19-9の異常高値はしばしば認められたが、STNの値はOEおよびMCTにおいて臨床病理学的因子の影響を受けなかった。OEおよびMCTにおける悪性腫瘍の検出に対するSTNの臨床的有用性については、さらなる検討が必要である。
